arguments.command:
# Get size of today's files and copy them to archive
TODAY="2026-05-12"
SRC="~/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions/"
DEST="~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/archive/$TODAY/"

mkdir -p "$DEST"

# Find today's files and copy
echo "Copying today's session files..."
find ~/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions/ -maxdepth 1 -type f -newermt "2026-05-12 00:00" ! -newermt "2026-05-13 00:00" -exec cp -v {} "$DEST" \; 2>&1 | wc -l

echo "---"
echo "Archive folder size:"
du -sh "$DEST"
echo "---"
echo "File count in archive:"
ls -1 "$DEST" | wc -l

arguments.command:
# Compress the archive folder
TODAY="2026-05-12"
DEST="~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/archive/$TODAY/"
ARCHIVE="~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/archive/$TODAY.tar.gz"

echo "Compressing archive..."
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE" -C ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/archive/ "$TODAY"

echo "Compressed archive created:"
ls -lh "$ARCHIVE"

echo "---"
echo "Compression ratio:"
ORIG=$(du -sb "$DEST" | awk '{print $1}')
COMP=$(du -sb "$ARCHIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
echo "Original: $(du -sh "$DEST" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "Compressed: $(du -sh "$ARCHIVE" | awk '{print $1}')"
python3 -c "print(f'Ratio: {100*($COMP/$ORIG):.1f}% of original size')" 2>/dev/null || echo "Ratio: $(echo "scale=1; 100*$COMP/$ORIG" | bc)% of original size"

# Remove uncompressed folder after successful compression
if [ -f "$ARCHIVE" ] && [ $(stat -c%s "$ARCHIVE") -gt 1000 ]; then
    rm -rf "$DEST"
    echo "---"
    echo "Removed uncompressed folder. Archive ready."
fi

arguments.command:
# The folder was deleted before tar completed properly. Let's redo this properly.
TODAY="2026-05-12"
SRC="~/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions/"
DEST="~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/archive/$TODAY/"
ARCHIVE="~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/archive/$TODAY.tar.gz"

# Remove the broken archive
rm -f "$ARCHIVE"

# Recreate the folder and copy files again
mkdir -p "$DEST"
echo "Copying files..."
find ~/.openclaw/agents/main/sessions/ -maxdepth 1 -type f -newermt "2026-05-12 00:00" ! -newermt "2026-05-13 00:00" -exec cp {} "$DEST" \;

echo "Files copied: $(ls -1 "$DEST" | wc -l)"
echo "Size: $(du -sh "$DEST" | awk '{print $1}')"

# Now compress properly
echo "Compressing..."
tar -czf "$ARCHIVE" -C ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/archive/ "$TODAY"

echo "Archive created: $(ls -lh "$ARCHIVE" | awk '{print $5}')"

# Verify archive contents
echo "Verifying archive..."
tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE" | wc -l

# Only remove source if archive looks good
ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$ARCHIVE")
if [ "$ARCHIVE_SIZE" -gt 1000000 ]; then
    rm -rf "$DEST"
    echo "Removed uncompressed folder. Archive is $(du -sh "$ARCHIVE" | awk '{print $1}')."
else
    echo "WARNING: Archive seems small ($ARCHIVE_SIZE bytes). Keeping uncompressed folder."
fi
